items.title: Gamma irradiation shapes high value metabolite responses across microbes microalgae and plants.
items.hook: Gamma irradiation alters redox and metabolic regulation in microalgae, affecting high‑value metabolite production.

items.title: Concentration-dependent modulation of cadmium toxicity by molybdenum in Chlorella pyrenoidosa: Multi-endpoint evidence for an antioxidant compensation-to-overload transition.
items.hook: Shows how molybdenum modulates cadmium toxicity in Chlorella pyrenoidosa, revealing antioxidant compensation and overload transitions.

items.title: Acyltransferases in Microbial Triacylglycerol Biosynthesis: Structure, Mechanisms, Regulation, and Engineering.
items.journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
items.hook: Describes acyltransferases involved in microbial triacylglycerol biosynthesis, detailing structure, mechanisms, regulation, and engineering potential.

items.title: From granulation to disintegration: role of filamentous microalgae and multi-community succession in microalgae-bacteria granular sludge reactor.
items.hook: Demonstrated that filamentous microalgae and community succession improve granulation and wastewater treatment performance in a microalgae-bacteria granular sludge reactor.

items.title: Aqueous phase leachates from pure and commercial microplastics differentially affect the physiology and metabolism of Chlorella sp. MM3.
items.hook: Demonstrates that aqueous leachates from different microplastics alter the physiology and metabolism of Chlorella sp. MM3.

items.title: Occurrence of potentially harmful phytoplankton and phycotoxins in eastern oysters within a coastal Alabama estuary.
items.hook: Occurrence of potentially harmful phytoplankton and phycotoxins was documented in eastern oysters within a coastal Alabama estuary, highlighting exposure risks.

items.title: Phototrophs trade growth for defense through graded regulatory states under escalating oxidative stress.
items.hook: Synechococcus elongatus PCC 7942 was shown to trade growth for defense under escalating oxidative stress, revealing graded regulatory states.

items.title: Genome-wide identification and characterization of Arabidopsis domain of unknown function 1995 (DUF1995) gene family.
items.hook: DUF1995 is an ancient cyanobacteria-originated family.

items.title: Environmental fate of antibiotics, microplastics, and heavy metals under algal-bloom conditions: A review of interactions and ecological risks.
items.hook: The increasing co-occurrence of antibiotics, microplastics, and heavy metals in eutrophic waters has intensified concerns over combined pollution under algal-bloom conditions.

items.title: Composition, sources, and fate of fluorescent dissolved organic matter in the East China Sea under contrasting river discharge regimes.
items.hook: Understanding dissolved organic matter (DOM) dynamics in river-dominated marginal seas is essential for constraining coastal carbon budgets.
